description:
Terracotta Jali Tiles 010 are a black geometric jali with an interlocking cross-and-diamond pattern, as the product photo shows, for a bold feature wall that stands apart from the usual red clay.

## How it looks
The photo shows a dark, near-black screen where crosses and diamonds lock together into a continuous geometric lattice. A dark jali tends to look graphic and modern, especially against white plaster, light stone or timber, and light coming through the openings shows up strongly against the dark face. Colour on screens can differ from the real piece, so check the actual tone on a sample before you order.

## Where it works
- **Dark jali screen** for an entrance, reception or lobby feature wall.
- **Cross and diamond jali** panels on a modern elevation, balcony or rooftop.
- **Interlocking geometric jali design** as a room partition where a red clay tone would clash with the interior.

Dark surfaces tend to absorb more heat in direct sun, so on a sunny outdoor wall consider leaving an air gap behind the screen.

## Good to know
- Category: terracotta jali
- Pattern: interlocking cross-and-diamond geometric (from the product photo)
- Colour: dark / black as shown; confirm the finish and how the colour is achieved before ordering
- Size and thickness are not listed online yet.

Lay out a few pieces dry so the crosses and diamonds line up. Clean with water and a soft brush; avoid acid cleaners, which can dull a dark surface.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the true colour, and send your wall size for a dated quote. Read the [terracotta jali guide](/blog/terracotta-jali-in-pakistan-designs-uses-and-ordering-guide) or browse the full [terracotta jali range](/categories/terracotta-jali).

faqs.q: What is the price of black geometric jali?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the design, the quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Is a black jali suitable for an outdoor wall?
faqs.a: It can be, but dark surfaces tend to get hotter in direct sun. On a sunny wall, an air gap behind the screen helps. Confirm the finish with Pak Clay for outdoor use.

faqs.q: Black jali or natural terracotta jali: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Natural terracotta gives a warm, traditional look; a black jali reads as modern and graphic and contrasts with white or light stone walls. See both side by side at a showroom.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Terracotta Jali Tiles 010" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
